name: kubota-outfit-components
description: Kubota-specific reusable components for Outfit template projects.

scripts.preversion: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.release:patch: npm run preversion && npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm run preversion && npm version minor && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm run preversion && npm version major && git push origin main --follow-tags
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir tools/resizing-tool test --runInBand
scripts.build:resizer: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir tools/resizing-tool run build:webpack
scripts.build:preview: pnpm run build && pnpm --dir tools/resizing-tool exec webpack --env preview --mode production
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm run typecheck:resizer && pnpm --dir tools/resizing-tool run build:webpack && pnpm --dir tools/resizing-tool exec webpack --env preview --mode production
